note: Christian camp near Susquehanna (Susquehanna Co) that runs a public family campground open to all (online nightly booking). Water/electric sites (20/30 amp on some, 20 amp on the rest), five with sewer; RVs to 40 ft on seven sites, most others 27-30 ft. Open May 15-Oct 12 in 2026, closed to campers July 19-31 for youth camps. Note: no-alcohol and conduct standards apply. On-site lake (RV sites not on it). --Claude
summary: Confirmed water+sewer, 40-ft max and the 2026 rates ($37 W/E, $42 with sewer, dated 2026 rate sheet); added 30-amp top electric (20/30 on listed sites, 20 elsewhere), season May 15-Oct 12 with the July 19-31 youth-camp suspension, online ResNexus booking opening Nov 1, showers. Note corrected: '30-amp max' detail, July closure, dropped 'non-discrimination policy' wording not found on the pages.
flags: Conduct standards in the 2026 Campground Guidelines PDF go beyond no-alcohol: campers are 'expected to abide by our standards of behavior/practice that align with our beliefs on biblical sexuality', unrelated guests of different sexes must lodge separately, restrooms by biological sex. Not a criteria failure as written (public, individually bookable), noted for a human. The family campground also closes July 19-31 every year for youth camps.
